name: Svensk författningssamling (SFS): Swedish statutes as consolidated in SFST
label: Sweden
record_note: Current-only: the sources keep one consolidation per statute (the text "t.o.m. SFS ..."), no earlier versions. Each statute appears on the in-force day of the latest amending act its consolidation includes (SFSR register), so the record of a statute starts there. Real dated changes: provisions the consolidation prints in two dated versions ("/Upphör att gälla U:date/", "/Träder i kraft I:date/") change on that date, credited to the act named in the new text; repealed statutes are deleted on their repeal day, credited to the repealing act. Checked against the source on 2026-10-28.

dates.commit: in-force (see Date-source: sfsr-amendment, sfsr-in-force, issued, marker, upphavd)
dates.time: 12:00 Europe/Stockholm (CET +01:00; CEST +02:00 from 1980: 1980 6 Apr-28 Sep, 1981-1995 last Sunday of March-last Sunday of September, from 1996 last Sunday of March-last Sunday of October)
dates.before_1970: clamped to 1970-01-01 (seconds apart); the real day is in In-force

author.enacted: the statute itself, when the register lists no amendment in force

scope.when_absent: no scope note found; not a statement that the change reaches every case (transitional provisions are in each statute's overgang.md)

default_reach.rule: no retroactive criminal law or taxes; otherwise transitional provisions decide
default_reach.meaning: a statute applies from its entry into force; criminal sanctions and taxes may not be imposed retroactively, and for crimes the law at the time of the act applies unless a later law is milder; for other law the act's own övergångsbestämmelser say what happens to earlier facts
default_reach.authority: Regeringsformen (1974:152) 2 kap. 10 §; lagen (1964:163) om införande av brottsbalken 5 §
